description: Object events slice 5 (context/designs/modding/object-events.md): the level's lift and glass rules are its level program. Defection, which has 2 lifts with 8 lift doors and 83 glass objects. The harness has player 0 use the nearest lift door (use_lift_door): the door use runs the door rule, whose og.door.activate calls the lift, so event.lift.called runs gate.lift.native_vacant and og.lift.go_to_stop; the lifts' own waits and arrivals run event.lift.idle and event.lift.arrived. It then breaks the two nearest glass objects with a shot each (damage_glass): event.glass.damaged runs gate.glass.native_broken and og.glass.break, and event.glass.broken follows. Every decision is compared with the original rule; the stage's totals are logged at the scripted exit.

input_sequence.comment: Pause until the player is spawned, live and walking; the bounded Skip assist ends the intro.
The nearest lift door: the door rule runs, and through og.door.activate the lift is called.
The nearest unbroken glass takes a shot and breaks.
The lifts have waited and arrived meanwhile; the stage's totals are logged at the exit.
